transcript:
[00:00] Laura: alright everyone thanks for joining, uh it's 2pm so we'll kick off the weekly it finance security sync. I think we have a full list, um if we can go around real quick for any blockers?
[00:12] Samir: hey Laura, Samir here. main thing, we scheduled the billing exporter update, there's a note — the service account key needs rotation before month end, I still need to coordinate with GCP team to update the BigQuery sink.
[00:26] Laura: ok, that's urgent because finance needs the billing exports to match the new cost tags. Priya you had flagged mismatches last week?
[00:33] Priya: yeah the QuickBooks mapping had like three tag sets missing, some of the cost center tags came through as null so we couldn't allocate correctly.
[00:42] Diego: also from a security perspective we want the key rotation to be atomic with the new IAM policy, otherwise we'll get orphaned exports. Also related, the SOC 2 evidence bucket — I uploaded new items but there's some filename inconsistencies so the auditor tooling fails parsing, short term fix is renaming them.
[00:56] Maya: can Diego put the link in the chat? we need to be able to share that with the working group.
[01:02] Diego: yes, I'll drop the folder link; it's in the shared drive: drive.redwood.internal/security/soc2/jan2025 — note it's missing the change control CSV.
[01:12] John: quick Q — are we on track to have the primary evidence for access reviews? I know we did an access scrub in December but we need log extracts.
[01:20] Samir: logs are available but I need to run the retention query. There's also the kv cash misread — sorry, the KV cache rotation for the runtime was scheduled but it's unrelated to the audit.
[01:33] John: (laughs) kv cash yeah.
[01:36] Laura: alright, let's be explicit. Samir will rotate the billing exporter service account keys and confirm in chat. Diego will assemble the SOC 2 evidence + initial gap list. Laura will re-send the cost allocation tags doc with a mapping to QuickBooks. Ben from legal will review retention language. Maya will schedule follow up.
[01:52] Ben: I'll take a look at the retention wording, especially the legal hold clauses and the data deletion section to make sure it's auditable.
[01:59] Priya: on finance side, also want to confirm that cost tags are applied to both hosted and dedicated billing lines — our dedicated capacity invoices weren't tagged correctly last quarter.
[02:10] Samir: noted, that's related to how the exporter labels GCE/VM instances vs. dedicated infra. I'll make sure the new keys include the updated label set.
[02:18] Diego: another item — SSO verification. Okta handed us a new metadata file and I think sam-el assertion name was slightly different so some SAML assertions failed in staging. We need to push a fix to the SSO config and test with a couple of accounts.
[02:33] Aisha: for payroll, we need confirmation that employee invoice exports will not include PII. There was a line item last month where a note included a full name and partial address.
[02:42] Maya: we have a masking rule in place but it seems it wasn't applied in that export flow. Samir can we check the masking rule for the payroll export pipeline?
[02:50] Samir: yes, looks like a filter didn't run in the new pipeline. I'll add the masking step before export and run a dry-run in staging.
[02:57] Laura: perfect. Diego, what about KMS/HSM usage for key storage? are we ok to store exporter keys in our managed KMS?
[03:05] Diego: yes managed KMS is fine; for production billing exporters we want to use the HSM-protected keys for root rotation. Also we'll log all key access in audit logs — remember that the auditor will want to see the key access trail.
[03:17] John: timeline question — can we have the key rotation and evidence handoff before the end of February? auditors are aiming for a March slot but they'd like to see handoff in late Feb.
[03:26] Diego: doable, but it depends on the gaps list. If the gap list is small (<=5 items) we can patch quickly; if larger we might need a remediation plan.
[03:35] Laura: okay let's aim for the 2025-02-24 internal freeze for audit readiness. Maya can you set that as a soft date?
[03:42] Maya: yeah I'll propose times for a readiness review week of 2025-02-10 and we can push tasks to meet the 02-24 freeze.
[03:50] Priya: also cost-related — once tags are fixed, can we run a reconciliation for Q4 and produce an adjustment sheet? we had mismatches that affected revenue recognition.
[03:59] Laura: yes, after Samir confirms the exporter changes we'll run reconciliation. Priya, who on your team will own that?
[04:05] Priya: I'll own it but I'll need Aisha's help for payroll specific lines.
[04:10] Aisha: happy to help; just need the sample exports and the masked/dry-run confirmation.
[04:17] Ben: legal/retention: on deletion windows, are we still at 90 days for non-prod logs and 1 year for prod? The policy doc i saw looked like 180/3 years for some categories.
[04:26] Diego: policy is a mix; we updated some categories last quarter. Ben, I'll share a consolidated retention table in the evidence bucket so legal can mark acceptable lines.
[04:36] Ben: cool. Please highlight any lines that require legal hold exceptions.
[04:41] Samir: quick technical note: the billing exporter is using a service account with two keys right now, rotating means creating a new key, updating the sink, validating exports, then deleting the old key. I'll schedule maintenance window 02-02 evening PT to avoid billing runs. If anyone objects, flag now.
[04:58] John: ok evening is fine.
[05:01] Laura: no objections. Make sure to post the maintenance notice to #ops and finance.
[05:07] Samir: will do.
[05:09] Maya: Diego also mentioned filename inconsistencies — can you add a short script to normalize filenames so the auditor tooling doesn't choke? it can run as a one-off.
[05:17] Diego: yes i have a small python script, i'll drop it in the shared folder and run a normalization pass.
[05:24] Priya: last quick Q — do we have a single source of truth for cost tag definitions? I think we do but it's not enforced in infra as code.
[05:33] Samir: we have a tags csv in infra repo but enforcement is manual. long term we should add a policy in the infra pipeline to reject untagged resources.
[05:42] Laura: add that to roadmap but not a blocker for the audit.
[05:46] John: ok to wrap — recap of next steps?
[05:50] Laura: recap: Samir rotates billing exporter keys (due 02-04 confirmation), Diego uploads SOC 2 evidence and gap list (due 02-07), Laura re-sends cost tag mapping (due 01-31), Ben reviews retention language (due 02-03), Maya schedules the readiness follow-up (due 01-30). I'll send minutes after the call.
[06:08] Samir: one more — I'll include the staging dry-run logs for masking so payroll can review.
[06:13] Aisha: thanks.
[06:15] Diego: link to evidence folder in chat now (drive.redwood.internal/security/soc2/jan2025).
[06:20] Laura: thanks everyone. meeting adjourned.
